ui.languageDescription: Choose the language used throughout your console.
ui.error: This operation could not be completed. Try again.
ui.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in.
ui.connectIntro: Connect the tools that hold your components.
ui.githubDescription: Read repository metadata and discover components through GitHub MCP.
ui.githubTokenHint: Grant read access only to the repositories you want to import.
ui.projectsIntro: One repository per project. Your components, your composition.
ui.projectsEmpty: Connect GitHub and import your first repository.
ui.selectComponents: Select components to include in this project.
ui.noComponents: No supported components were discovered. Check the repository and revision.
ui.name: Name
ui.runtimesIntro: Compose, configure and follow every connected execution.
ui.runtimeEmpty: Create a microruntime from one of your projects.
ui.configurationIntro: Resource limits apply to each execution. Agent settings are independent of application dependencies.
ui.migrationHint: Leave empty for a new microruntime. Existing resources must be confirmed stopped before migration.
ui.buildHint: Use a build recipe that already exists in this repository. Commands run on your connected machines.
ui.invalidBuild: Select at least one component and provide valid build arguments as an array of strings.
ui.configurationLocked: Configuration is locked until every execution is confirmed stopped.
ui.deleteConfirm: Delete this microruntime? Starts will be blocked and connected environments will be asked to clean up. History is retained.
ui.revokeConfirm: Revoke access and prevent automatic resumption?
ui.operationRequested: Request recorded. Awaiting confirmation from each environment.
ui.environmentsEmpty: No agent has connected yet. Follow the connection instructions.
ui.secretOnce: Copy your runtime secret now. It is shown only once. Keep it out of Git and logs.
ui.setupInstructions: In your project checkout, initialize LangDrift, enter the secret privately, connect, then run the agent. The credential is stored in the ignored runtime .env file.
ui.recommendationIntro: Suggestions use this project’s history. You review and save them before anything changes.
ui.insufficientEvidence: There is not enough comparable history yet. Enter your settings manually.
ui.providerUnavailable: Recommendations are unavailable. Check the provider configuration.
ui.purgeConfirm: Permanently erase this runtime’s history and recommendations? This cannot be undone. Cleanup obligations remain.
ui.historicalConfiguration: Previously configured; effectiveness was not measured
ui.agentSettingsHint: The LangDrift reasoning agent runs recommendations in the console using these settings. The local executor interprets configuration deterministically. Until a model is selected, suggestions use the operator-configured initial model.

recommendationReasons.review_cited_evidence: Review the proposed values against the cited project episodes and the limitations for each field.
recommendationReasons.resource_observations_missing: There are not enough comparable resource observations. Enter the required values manually.
recommendationReasons.provider_not_configured: The recommendation provider is not configured.
recommendationReasons.model_not_allowed: The selected model is not allowed by the service configuration.
recommendationReasons.provider_endpoint_invalid: The configured recommendation endpoint is invalid.
recommendationReasons.provider_request_failed: The recommendation request failed. Try again later or enter values manually.
recommendationReasons.provider_response_invalid: The provider returned an invalid recommendation. Enter values manually.
recommendationReasons.stub_suggestion: Synthetic suggestion from extub seeds; no RAG or model request was performed.

recommendationLimits.future_workload_unverified: Samples come from previous executions; comparable future workload performance is unverified.
recommendationLimits.cpu_observation_missing: CPU has no cited observation supporting a suggestion; enter it manually.
recommendationLimits.memory_observation_missing: Memory has no cited observation supporting a suggestion; enter it manually.
recommendationLimits.agent_quality_unmeasured: Model and effort repeat historical configuration choices. Their quality, consumption, and performance were not measured.

ui.localProjectIntro: Choose a folder on this computer to connect your project.
ui.localProjectsIntro: Each project has one folder and one agent for all its microruntimes.
ui.browseFolder: or click to browse this computer
ui.confirmFolderPath: Your browser does not share the absolute folder path. Enter it below or choose the folder to confirm.
ui.projectAgentIntro: One project, one .langdrift folder, one connected agent. Microruntimes start only when you request it.
ui.unknownExecutions: {count, plural, one {# execution has an unknown state. Its stop is not confirmed.} other {# executions have unknown states. Their stops are not confirmed.}}
ui.runningExecutions: {count, plural, one {# confirmed running execution} other {# confirmed running executions}}
ui.noRunningRuntimes: No microruntimes are currently confirmed running.
ui.projectSecretsIntro: Manage connection credentials for this project’s agent. Account preferences remain in Settings.
ui.projectSecretOnce: Copy this secret now. It will not be shown again. Use it as PROJECT_SECRET for this project’s agent; keep it outside version control.
ui.revokeProjectSecretConfirm: Revoke this project credential? Its environments will be denied new starts and must confirm any pending stops.
ui.noLocalComponents: No Dockerfile components were found. Add a build recipe to your project, then refresh.
ui.graphUnavailable: Graph unavailable; component details remain below.
ui.llmBudgetHint: A reporting budget, not an automatic spending limit.
ui.topologyUnavailable: Container connections have not been observed. Nodes show configured components.
ui.testEvidenceUnavailable: Tests · No recorded test, load, or security results.
ui.finopsBasis: CPU/RAM are agent observations against configured limits. LLM cost is cumulative per execution when reported; budget suggestions are estimates. Missing billing, topology, and test evidence stay unavailable. No savings or budget enforcement is implied.
ui.costUnavailable: Cost and budget unavailable without evidence.
ui.ticketMemoryHint: Select a credential-free ticket to analyze with persistent project memory. Its contents are sent to the configured model only when requesting suggestions.
ui.stubBanner: Local preview · simulated microruntimes. HTTP burst timings are measured on the local stub.
ui.webrtcFallback: HTTP seed preview · WebRTC not connected
ui.topologySynthetic: Simulated container connections from extub seeds.
ui.peakPerExecution: Highest reported value per execution; missing data stays unavailable.
ui.graphColorLegend: Graph activation: green <50% · yellow 50–75% · orange 75–90% · red ≥90%. Purple: stopped or unavailable.
ui.loadTestScope: 50 HTTP attempts, up to 50 concurrent, only against the local extub stub. Stops within a 3-second budget, with a 10-second cooldown. No workloads or external targets.
ui.loadTestObserved: Measured stub API timings, including failures; not a workload capacity or security test.
ui.loadTestEmpty: No burst result recorded. The test is available while this microruntime is running.
ui.activityIntro: All microruntimes in this project, newest first. Scroll for older records; refresh for current observations.
ui.secretCopyFailed: Clipboard access failed. Allow clipboard access and try again.
ui.costOverviewDescription: The LLM cost, CPU and memory each runtime reported, against its limits and budget. A cost no execution reported stays unavailable.
ui.unreportedLlmCosts: {count, plural, =0 {Every execution reported its LLM cost} one {# of {total} executions without a reported LLM cost} other {# of {total} executions without a reported LLM cost}}
ui.ticketsIntro: Every ticket in this project, newest first, with the artifacts it links. Scroll for older tickets.
ui.analysisIntro: Every ticket the agent has analyzed: the documents it read, the episodes it cited, and the model and effort it suggests.
ui.plansIntro: Every ticket with a plan: the components it would run and the envelope that bounds them, pending the team's authorization.
ui.workflowsIntro: Every ticket with a workflow: its stages, the spend it reserves against the budget, and where its pull request stands.
